messages:
anya: Noticed spikes in provisional tokens during last canary when streaming sessions retried after tool truncation. Suspect duplicate chunk credits across new sessions.
sam: Did router create new request IDs on reconnects?
kevin: Yes, router starts fresh sessions on circuit-handovers, so ledger keys (session-scoped) don't dedupe.
lucy: Short fix idea: reconciler can fingerprint chunks (sha256(normalized_prompt+model+chunk_index)) and merge provisional entries within 2m.
anya: Good. Heuristic: require either tool truncation flag OR small token/byte delta to merge. Don't merge across different customer accounts.
billing-bot: We accept merge requests via POST /internal/billing/merge {merge_id, fingerprints, sessions, merged_tokens}. Finance will throttle auto-refunds.
kevin: Plan: add reconciler.feature.chunk_fingerprint behind flag; emit reconciler.chunk_merge_* metrics. Also add router.feature.preserve_request_id for targeted rollout.
deploy-bot: Canary planned: reconciler-canary -> canary-cluster -> 2024-02-11T06:00Z.
anya: Console: group merged provisional lines and surface a timeline note "merged duplicate chunk due to reconnect" linking to trace. Lucy to mock UI.
sam: Tests: unit for fingerprint normalization, integration sim for truncation+reconnect, e2e for console merge visibility.
kevin: I'll open PRs for reconciler + router patch. Lucy, billing-team: coordinate on merge API shape and throttles.
anya: Thanks everyone. Will monitor merge metrics during canary and hold refunds low-rate for first two hours.
sam: +1 :thumbsup:
